resources.string: Show note button on Trans. tab.
Open a transaction you enter often and tap Bookmark. Next time, pick it from here or from the star on the entry screen to fill the form in one tap.
On the first day of every month
Recurring transactions are applied on the first day of every month. The recurring transactions until %1$s are reflected in advance. Do you want to continue?
Tap + here, or choose Rep/Inst. › Repeat on the entry screen. Nexo then adds the transaction automatically on each date.
